segments.title: 第167章 誒,真乖
segments.content:
"You have to grip it a little lower, and you can't use too much force. Lift it gently. Yes, slowly."

In the classroom of Class 16, Year One, Li Luo stood beside Ying Chanxi, softly reminding and instructing her by her ear, "Pay attention to the angle of the chopsticks. You have to be parallel to the bottom, understand? Otherwise, won't it just slip off?"

Seeing Ying Chanxi fail again, unable to pick up the marble in the bowl with her chopsticks and move it to the bowl on the other table, Li Luo shook his head with a helpless smile.

The game in Class 16 was simple: picking up marbles.

The two tables were placed one meter apart.

Participants only needed to use chopsticks to move five marbles from the bowl on the left to the bowl on the other table within the time limit to pass.

Li Luo had passed on his first try.

But Ying Chanxi had been stuck here for a long time.

"Ugh, you're so annoying," Ying Chanxi said, pouting, as she watched the marble fall to the floor again. "It's all because you're babbling in my ear, distracting me."

Li Luo was speechless.

"Alright, alright." He raised his hands in surrender and simply retreated to the back doorway of the classroom. "Is it okay if I stand this far away?"

"Hmph, you just wait." After a student from Class 16 refilled the bowl with five marbles, Ying Chanxi immediately rolled up her sleeves, determined to conquer these few marbles.

However, just as Li Luo was leaning against the back door with his arms crossed, watching the show, a girl suddenly came to his side and asked gently, "Are you Li Luo from Class 8?"

Being approached by someone out of the blue, Li Luo was slightly stunned. He turned to look at the girl who had struck up a conversation.

The school uniform suited her well, complementing her soft and graceful face.

She was a very pretty girl.

Although not on par with Ying Chanxi, she could still be considered a little beauty at Fuyi High School, surely not lacking admirers among the boys.

"Is something wrong?" Li Luo tilted his head and asked, puzzled.

"Nothing, I just wanted to get to know you." The girl smiled slightly, tucking a strand of hair behind her ear. "My name is Shen Shuhua, I'm from Class 16."

"Oh, hello."

"I really liked the song you sang during military training, and your performances at the opening and closing ceremonies of the sports meet were amazing," Shen Shuhua said shyly, lowering her head. "I hope I'm not bothering you by coming over so abruptly."

"Well, you are, a little." Li Luo's gaze met Ying Chanxi's, who was staring over. He then watched as Ying Chanxi, in a flurry of movements, picked up all the marbles.

In about twenty seconds, all five marbles had landed safely in the bowl.

She had demonstrated the terrifying potential of a human pushed to their limits.

"Ah?" Shen Shuhua was slightly taken aback, and then she saw Ying Chanxi quickly walk over to Li Luo's side.

"Let's go, I'm done," Ying Chanxi said calmly to Li Luo, without even a glance at Shen Shuhua.

"We can go," Li Luo said, pointing at Shen Shuhua beside him, "but I think she has the stamp. Don't you want to get yours stamped first?"

"Yes." Shen Shuhua smiled faintly. "I just switched shifts with a classmate. It's my turn to stamp for you. Student Ying Chanxi, let me stamp it for you."

"You know me?" Ying Chanxi gave Shen Shuhua a strange look.

"How could I not know the person who ranked first in the year?" Shen Shuhua shook her head with a smile, took the stamp collection booklet from Ying Chanxi's hand, and stamped it for her. "There you go."

"Okay." Ying Chanxi took back her booklet and then looked at Li Luo.

"Let's go." Li Luo didn't pay much more attention to Shen Shuhua either. He waved at Ying Chanxi and started walking towards the staircase.

Ying Chanxi jogged to catch up, and the two of them headed to the fourth floor.

Back in the Class 16 classroom, several girls gathered around Shen Shuhua, whispering excitedly.

"How did the chat go?"

"With Xiao Shu making a move, there's definitely no problem."

"But that Ying Chanxi was right there."

"They're cousins. Didn't I find that out for you ages ago?"

"But why do I feel like Ying Chanxi looked a little jealous?"

"Really? Isn't she just a bit arrogant by nature? I mean, she is first in the year."

"Alright, alright." Shen Shuhua felt a bit helpless listening to them. "I was just getting to know him. I never said I was going to do anything."

"Hee hee, but didn't you say in the dorm that your favorite type is a heartthrob full of musical talent? Li Luo fits that perfectly."

"He got 15th in the whole school on the last monthly exam, and he's in a parallel class! So amazing."

"He can also play the guitar. He even sang and played solo at the sports meet. I heard from people in Class 8 that he wrote that song himself."

"Damn! What a perfect guy!"

"He's also quite handsome."

"Yes, yes! The way he was leaning against the back door just now, that vibe…"

"Okay, okay, we still have work to do in the classroom," Shen Shuhua said, hastily interrupting them as their praise grew more and more exaggerated. "I told you, I was just getting to know him. You guys talk way too much."

"Are you shy, Xiao Shu?"

"You're obviously crushing on him, haha…"

The girls chattered and teased.

Meanwhile.

Li Luo, walking upstairs with Ying Chanxi, was completely unaware that he had become some sort of heartthrob in the girls' circles.

What he hadn't realized himself was that the series of events that had happened to him in the few months since school started was enough to have a considerable lethal effect on girls of this age.

After all, who would refuse a boy who could sing and play the guitar, was humorous and witty, an outstanding class president, and also ranked among the top in academics?

With all these halos, and with Ying Chanxi nagging him daily to wash his face with cleanser and take care of his skin.

Li Luo looked much fairer than in his past life, and his entire demeanor was completely different.

This even made him appear more attractive in the eyes of the girls.

Originally, he was handsome, but not to the level of Daniel Wu. Later in life, his posture worsened, and he gained weight, gradually turning into an ordinary middle-aged uncle.

But now, at only 16 years old, Li Luo, from his looks to his figure, complemented by the aura of a top student and a guitarist, was indeed very handsome from an outsider's perspective.

"What did that person say to you just now?" While climbing the stairs, Ying Chanxi couldn't help but turn her head and ask.

"Just that she wanted to get to know me," Li Luo said, finding her suspicious expression a little funny. "Shen Shuhua from Class 16, do you know her?"

"No." Ying Chanxi shook her head. "Do you remember her?"

"A little."

"You knew her before?" Ying Chanxi narrowed her eyes.

"Not really." Li Luo shook his head. "Her grades seem pretty good. She was 43rd in the school on the mid-term exam, and 47th on the last monthly exam. That's a very decent score for someone in a parallel class."

"You even know that?" Ying Chanxi's eyes widened. "And you say you don't know her?"

"I just have a good memory." Li Luo rolled his eyes at her. "I can recite the rankings of everyone in your class."

Reminded by Li Luo, Ying Chanxi remembered.

She didn't know when this guy had had his breakthrough, but he could always remember some strange and obscure things.

Ying Chanxi highly suspected that the frantic studying before the high school entrance exam had left him with some kind of side effect.

His memory had actually become this good.

"So besides getting to know you, did she say anything else?" Ying Chanxi asked again.

"Before she could say anything else, someone had already passed the level." Li Luo glanced at her and asked back with great suspicion, "Were you faking it before when you couldn't pick up the marbles?"

"You're the one who fakes things!" Ying Chanxi suddenly quickened her pace. "Let's go, let's go, only five more classes to collect! I want to go for the lucky draw."

"Alright, alright."

The two had started their sweep from Class 7 on the third floor. After collecting all the stamps from the classes on the two lower floors, they came all the way up to the fourth floor, starting from Class 1.

The Sudoku game obviously posed no challenge to the two of them.

Soon, Li Luo led Ying Chanxi to the entrance of Class 3.

"Yo, isn't that my Brother Jun?" Spotting Zhao Rongjun in the classroom, Li Luo immediately waved and called out.

Seeing Li Luo and Ying Chanxi, Zhao Rongjun nodded in acknowledgment. "Are you guys here to play?"

"What else would we be here for?" Li Luo chuckled. "Don't tell me you can just stamp it for us?"

"I can't do that." Zhao Rongjun shook his head repeatedly. "The stamp is with Luo Jiajia right now."

"Isn't that perfect? You won't even give your deskmate some face?"

"Stop talking nonsense," Zhao Rongjun rolled his eyes. "Are you playing or not?"

"Of course we're playing. What's your class's game again?" Li Luo tried to recall. The game for Class 3 seemed to be called "Blind Man Dotting the Eyes."

Ying Chanxi also looked at the game announcement posted at the door, which detailed the rules.

"You need two people to participate over here," Zhao Rongjun said. "If there's only one person, we staff can also help out."

"But you two definitely won't need that. You can just be partners."

"Now, look at the three dragons on the blackboard. None of them have eyes."

"The two of you will get ready at the back of the classroom. One person stays at the back, the other wears a blindfold. The former directs the latter. If you can successfully draw the eyes on one dragon, the person wearing the blindfold passes."

"That sounds pretty simple." Li Luo raised an eyebrow and looked at Ying Chanxi. "But it's probably not easy for a certain someone."

"Keep bragging," Ying Chanxi huffed. "If you've got the guts, let's compete and see who finishes in a shorter time."

"I'll definitely be much faster than you."

"You're not allowed to cheat," Ying Chanxi said, looking at him suspiciously. "You have to give good directions, no misguiding me. I'll have Zhao Rongjun supervise you."

"If you don't trust me that much, why don't you just have Zhao Rongjun direct you?"

"So inconsiderate." Ying Chanxi grabbed his sleeve and pulled him to the back of the classroom to queue up. "Zhao Rongjun is busy. You're still trying to trouble him."

"Then don't be a sore loser when you lose to me later."

"I won't." Ying Chanxi looked at the students participating in the game ahead of them and thought about the whole process.

It was just walking from the back of the classroom to the podium, picking up a piece of chalk, and drawing two eyes on the dragon's head.

Ying Chanxi felt it should be quite simple.

She would go first. No matter how long she took, when it was Li Luo's turn, couldn't she just mess with his directions?

Thinking this, Ying Chanxi's eyes darted around, and she was already starting to smile secretly.

So she immediately put on a straight face and turned to ask Li Luo, "Then if you lose later, is there a penalty?"

"The penalty will be you barking like a puppy three times," Li Luo said, stroking his chin thoughtfully.

"Why are you so obsessed with puppy barks?" Ying Chanxi looked at him, speechless.

"What?" Li Luo raised an eyebrow. "You don't dare?"

"Hmph, bring it on." Ying Chanxi had already made her plans and wasn't afraid at all. "You just wait to go woof woof woof."

"Aww, such a good girl."

"…?" Ying Chanxi froze for a moment, then realized what he meant. Flushed with embarrassment and anger, she punched him. "You're the worst!"

(End of Chapter)
